pr140.title: Agent 102: exact parameter intervals and quantified decisions for clipped affine words
pr140.body:
## Result

This contribution computes the exact set of natural parameters where two finite affine-run words are equal, as a finite union of half-open intervals, and specializes equality against the reversed run table for palindromes. It preserves actual per-parameter `Int.toNat` clipping, zero-length runs, literal digit zero, and original `wordAt` semantics.

Exact mathematical source checkpoint: `1c1bff874c915d90d2820090e028b40002145375`. This PR now targets `main` after PR93 and PR124 were merged. The source head remains the original checkpoint; the complete current-target diff is 242 additions and preserves the five inherited mathematical module blobs.

## Public interfaces

Namespace `Agent102.ParameterSets`:

- `holds_equalityRegions A B k`: membership iff actual `wordAt A k = wordAt B k`, for every natural `k`.
- `holds_palindromeRegions A k`: membership iff actual `wordAt A k = (wordAt A k).reverse`.
- `equivalentRegions_spec`: Boolean equality of represented parameter sets iff membership agrees for every natural parameter.
- Complete existential/universal equality, inequality, palindrome and nonpalindrome decisions built from interval membership, emptiness and complement.

Intervals may overlap or repeat. No minimal or disjoint normalization and no formal complexity bound are claimed. The executable interval solver does not enumerate a coefficient-sized cutoff prefix or expand the digit words.

## Evidence and exact current status

The registry at the exact head pins **13 modules and 140 explicit theorem exports**. The previously missing full-closure execution and independent combined review are complete.

- **Fresh strict build:** Agent #2/session `acfe54025bfc` rebuilt all 13 modules in a new directory using official Lean 4.19.0, commit `6caaee842e94`, with `--trust=0 -j1 -DElab.async=false`. All 18 recorded commands returned exit 0.
- **Literal and module-origin audits:** all 140 unique literal targets, including both `getElem?` names, were reported. The full imported-module census audited 403 theorem constants, including private and generated theorems. Their transitive axiom union is exactly `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. The 26 compiler-generated unsafe implementation records are separately retained; none is an audited theorem dependency.
- **Executable audit:** 16 selected roots cover the original five symbolic interfaces, equality and palindrome regions, extensional region equivalence, and all eight quantified decisions. Every root has nonzero project coverage and zero prohibited dependencies. Traversal stops at explicit standard-library frontier nodes; arbitrary caller-supplied callbacks and compiler implementation substitutions are outside that audit.
- **Concrete whole-set certificates:** all 10 certificate theorems and 10 exact membership bridges in `Agent102ParameterSetControls.lean` were rebuilt. The certificates are axiom-free; the bridges use only the permitted foundations.
- **Independent combined review:** Agent #11/session `c68be3818c4b` and genuine nonauthor specialists read all 13 modules and all 242 added files. Source-semantic review passed without a proof repair. The retained-evidence validator passed 1,499 consistency checks; a separate reconciliation accounted for every actual command and raw log line and passed 443 consistency checks.

Published evidence:

- [Independent source, mathematical-scope and preservation review](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/blob/367f07a3a45f6227eee45ac13c1a524f5afc4f7b/proofs/coordination/reviews/agent-11/sessionc68b/pr140/source-review-001/README.md).

Its 84-member archive is SHA256 `74a8aa1261a82266e510c09d4272036e04b6454e3b8340935b362de4018e58c4`; all eight published Git blob identities and all archive members were independently checked.

The exact executed runner is preserved separately from its later replay revision. The latter adds an early rejection of optimized Python so assertions cannot silently be disabled. Both versions, the unchanged passing run, and the deliberate rejection receipt remain retained.
